backend/main.mo: Defines core backend types for users, questions, tests, sessions, leaderboards, and suggestions, initializes authorization and storage mixins, and sets up maps for all major data collections.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short descriptions of all frontend files, summarizing functionality, styling, and recent fixes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point configuring MathJax globally and mounting the React application root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app container handling authentication, role checks, view activation, view persistence, and routing between core pages.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Generates a PDF performance report using jsPDF, filtering blocked users and rendering a banner, metadata, and statistics.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Renders a full comment system with posting, deleting, timestamps, and user-role handling for a question.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Displays the site footer with branding, attribution, and disclaimer text.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements the main navigation header with authentication, role-based options, and responsive menus.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Shows test-specific or overall leaderboards with ranking badges, tabs, and user highlighting.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Injects MathJax-rendered HTML math content and re-typesets when content or theme changes.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Generates a detailed PDF of test results per user using jsPDF, including banner, metadata, and attempt data.
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Exports a simplified PDF score report for a test's participants using jsPDF.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Renders a profile setup form that validates user input and saves a new user profile via a mutation hook. Includes UI for full name, mobile number, and optional email with success/error toasts.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Displays a dialog showing detailed question content with navigation and a PDF export option. Supports scrolling, metadata badges, and async PDF generation with toast feedback.
Shows a paginated, filterable gallery of questions with selection support and search. Handles filtering, pagination, checkbox toggles, and syncs selection with parent state.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Generates a PDF of users and their test attempts using jsPDF loaded from CDN. Builds a formatted report with banner, table layout, and paginated rows.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Provides a dialog for scheduling tests by selecting start and end datetimes, converting them to nanoseconds, and submitting via callback. Includes validation and toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Offers WhatsApp and Telegram sharing buttons that open platform share URLs with preset text. Displays a small share card UI with icons and toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Displays all user suggestions for admins with loading/error states and supports deleting entries via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: Provides a feedback form allowing users to submit suggestions with validation and character limits.
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: Admin interface for viewing, filtering, sorting, and managing users, including viewing stats and blocking/unblocking accounts.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Shows a fullscreen loading overlay when a view is being activated.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: Prompts users to subscribe to a YouTube channel and verifies subscription before granting access.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Context managing view activation states with start/finish functions and a safety timeout.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Fetches and bootstraps user roles for flicker-free role detection, reconciling with backend when available.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, exposing identity state, login, and logout helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines numerous React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data through an actor, including user profiles, tests, questions, metrics, and sessions.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind CSS layers, color variables, dark mode themes, and fixes for Radix UI overlays and dialog components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders a static About page describing the platform’s story, mission, and purpose using cards and UI components.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Implements the admin dashboard with tabs and tools for managing questions, tests, users, metrics, sessions, and exports using multiple data-query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page that loads user profile, roles, and test configs, then displays available tests and status with lazy‑loaded sections.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero content and login/start flow that redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Displays results for a completed test, including score, time taken, and test metadata, with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Main test-taking interface handling questions, answers, timing, session activity, dialogs, and test submission.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Utility for exporting questions to PDF using MathJax, html2canvas rendering, fallbacks, and header/footer generation.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: LocalStorage utilities to persist and retrieve per-principal user roles for faster admin/user UI rendering.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash-based), store them in sessionStorage, and retrieve or clear persisted values.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Handles saving, restoring, and clearing the last viewed app state using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining content paths, theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state describing frontend issues, known bugs, and feature requirements for fixing loading behavior and mobile menu overlay problems.
